programmes.funder: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción (CORFO), Chile
programmes.amount_note: Non-reimbursable co-financing of up to about 70% of project cost, historically capped around CLP 60,000,000, for startups that already have sales and need to scale.
programmes.deadline_note: Regional and national convocatorias with fixed windows; not continuous.
programmes.reopen_note: Semilla Expande follows Semilla Inicia in CORFO's ladder and opens in annual convocatorias. Watch corfo.cl and the regional Comités de Desarrollo Productivo.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company has sales and meets the revenue thresholds.
Apply during an open convocatoria on the CORFO platform.
Evaluation.
Award and milestone disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Chilean companies with demonstrated sales below a defined ceiling; counterpart contribution required.

programmes.funder: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción (CORFO), Chile
programmes.amount_note: Non-reimbursable co-financing of up to 75% of total project cost, capped at CLP 15,000,000, to achieve technical and commercial validation of a prototype or fast-implementation idea. Some regional committees have run editions at up to CLP 17,000,000.
programmes.deadline_note: Run through regional Comités de Desarrollo Productivo Regional, so windows open region by region rather than nationally at once. Check corfo.cl for which regions are currently open.
programmes.reopen_note: Semilla Inicia opens in staggered regional convocatorias each year. If your region is closed, another region's window may still be open but you must be based there. The Chile Atiende record was last updated 30 June 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Check corfo.cl for an open convocatoria in your region.
Prepare the project (technical and commercial validation plan) and the 25% counterpart.
Apply online through the CORFO platform in either of the two modalities.
Evaluation and award; funds disbursed against milestones.

eligibility.other_note: Open to natural persons and to companies that do not yet have sales; some editions cap company age at 18 months. Applicants must be based in the region running the convocatoria.

programmes.source_snippet: CORFO te cofinanciará con hasta el 75 % del costo total del proyecto, con un tope de $15.000.000, para generar la validación técnica y comercial.

programmes.amount_note: CORFO allocates funds to accredited incubators and accelerators (SSAF operators), which then sub-allocate to startups. Amounts per startup have historically run to around CLP 60 million across SSAF-Semilla and SSAF-Desafío tracks.
programmes.deadline_note: Startups apply to the SSAF operator (incubator or accelerator), not to CORFO directly. Each operator runs its own intake calendar.
programmes.reopen_note: CORFO periodically re-tenders the SSAF operator concessions. Between operator calls, startups should approach currently accredited incubators listed on corfo.cl.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify an accredited SSAF operator (incubator or accelerator).
Apply to that operator's intake.
Operator selects and sub-allocates the CORFO subsidy.
Milestone-based disbursement with incubation support.

documents_required.doc: Chilean company RUT or commitment to incorporate

eligibility.other_note: Chilean-based ventures; foreign founders can qualify by incorporating in Chile.

programmes.name_en: Sercotec Seed Capital for New Businesses
programmes.amount_note: Competitive fund promoting the creation and formalisation of new businesses, historically awarding around CLP 3.5 million per beneficiary for investment and working capital plus technical assistance.
programmes.deadline_note: Regional convocatorias with defined windows announced on sercotec.cl.
programmes.reopen_note: Sercotec opens Capital Semilla Emprende convocatorias annually by region; the national announcement is usually made in the first half of the year.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Sercotec platform.
Apply during your region's open convocatoria.
Evaluation and ranking.
Award, then execute the investment plan with a Sercotec agent.

documents_required.doc: Proof of no formal business start or recent start depending on the edition

eligibility.other_note: Chilean residents starting a business; aimed at micro-enterprise formalisation rather than technology startups.

programmes.amount_note: Equity-free grant plus a soft-landing package and one-year work visa support. Build has historically awarded around CLP 25 million (roughly USD 25,000-30,000) to each of up to 50 startups per generation, with two generations a year.
programmes.deadline_note: The Start-Up Chile website currently shows applications as closed between generations. Results from the most recent cycle were published in January 2026.
programmes.reopen_note: Start-Up Chile receives two Build generations of up to 50 startups each per year, so a new application window normally opens within a few months of a closure. Announcements are made on startupchile.org and corfo.cl; a past BIG cycle closed on 29 November with results in January.

procedure_steps.detail: Watch startupchile.org for the next generation window.
Submit the online application in English within the window.
Evaluation by external judges.
Selection, then relocate to Chile, incorporate or register locally and sign the CORFO contract.

eligibility.other_note: Open to founders of any nationality; the startup must be under three years old and founders must relocate to Chile for the programme duration. Equity-free.

programmes.source_snippet: Annually we receive 2 Build generations of up to 50 startups each
